hypothesis: Value-aware requirement reasoning can allocate oracle work better than syntax shapes or source-test rotation. Programmatic generation still owns all input choices.
scope: All pure source-generated candidates selected in the previous two-round campaign; no historical oracle answers or execution outcomes enter prompts.
claims: Allocation only. Selected tests need fresh assertion completion, complete validity review and native execution.
conclusion: Eight responses exceeded output length; one exceeded the selection count. Long per-candidate prose caused the model to enumerate the pool. This is an interface failure, not evidence of detection quality.
next_experiment: Use a compact ranking of immutable aliases and let the program enforce the selection count; keep the same source pool and budgets.
